Tap beer vs bottled beer at the "Beer Temple" BUYER BEWARE
Nov 2022
The local Homie IPA on tap at the Beer Temple is great .......... well balanced, hop forward and unfiltered. Very good tap beer, recommended ........ However avoid any of the imported bottled beers. While there is a great selection of over 100 imported high end German/ Belgian/US/and UK beers in bottles, many of them are hot on the shelves and well past their best before date. I was given a US Deschutes IPA from the fridge that was totally off, it was oxidised and flat and was too bad to drink. On checking the bottling date it was 3 years old. The staff argued that the beers were good for 5 years and still wanted payment for opening the bottle. We paid for our drinks less the bad beer but the staff insisted we pay for the bad beer that was opened that we couldn't drink. We refused and they tried to stop my wife and I from leaving by blocking our exit and locking the door so we couldn't get out. We had to push past them and unlock the door to leave. The Beer Temple is not a place where you go to worship beer .... it is where old beers go to die !! Buyer beware ......
